projects.name: Agent 执行评测台
projects.subtitle: 说完成了，真的完成了吗？
projects.subtitleEn: Did the agent actually complete the task?
projects.description: 用十个原创工单场景，把工具回执、数据库状态和最终回复放在一起检查。超时后核对原操作，避免重复写入。
projects.descriptionEn: Ten original ticket cases reconcile tool receipts, database state and final replies. Look up the original operation after a timeout to avoid duplicate writes.
metrics: 公开为非 AI 示例
projects.context: 写入可能已经成功，只是回执丢失。只看回复文本，会把“说完成”当成完成，或者在结果未知时重复提交。批准也必须对应具体参数，不能成为任意写入的通行证。
projects.contextEn: A write may commit even when its receipt is lost. Text-only evaluation can accept false completion or overlook duplicate effects. Approval must bind to concrete parameters rather than permit arbitrary writes.
approach: 批准绑定具体变更：服务端检查角色、目标工单、参数与预期版本。批准后换参数，不能沿用原来的授权。
结果未知，先查原操作：写入后超时场景中，恢复策略查询同一 operation_id，发现已提交后不再重复写入。公开首页展开的是已有程序记录。
把完成判定落到最终状态：判定同时检查处理组、工单状态、记录数、权限事件和回复。基础策略在超时后停在 unknown；它的数据库也已写入，差异在于是否完成核对。
approachEn: Bind approval to the exact change: The server checks role, ticket, parameters and expected version. Changing the action cannot reuse approval for a different payload.

Unknown result: inspect the original operation: After a post-commit timeout, the recovery strategy queries the same operation_id and does not repeat an already committed write. The homepage reveals this saved program record.

Ground completion in final state: Grade group, ticket status, note count, permission events and reply together. The baseline stops at unknown after timeout even though its database changed; reconciliation is the distinction.
projects.result: 公开可回放十个虚构场景的基础 / 恢复策略记录，并查看事件与最终数据。写入后超时样例保留一次业务提交、一条新增记录，工单仍打开；这是程序运行的结果，不是大模型测评成绩。 公开回放方便免配置查看，但不能替代重新执行。本地 API 可复现工具效果；真实模型适配器仍需配置和实测，不能把程序策略差异写成模型能力提升。
projects.resultEn: Public replay includes baseline and recovery records across ten fictional scenarios, with events and final data. The post-commit timeout sample has one commit, one note and an open ticket. These are program-run results, not model evaluation scores. Replay is easy to inspect but is not a fresh execution. The local API reproduces tool effects; the model adapter requires configuration and testing. Program-strategy differences do not establish model improvements.

question.zh: 提交超时了，工单真的没改吗？

decision.zh: 核对原操作与最终状态，避免重复写入；批准只对具体变更生效。
decision.en: Reconcile the same operation and final state; approval is bound to the specific change.

projects.name: 偏爱实验室
projects.subtitle: 喜欢整张，不代表喜欢每个参数
projects.subtitleEn: Liking a poster is not a preference for every parameter
projects.description: 把自己的文案放进六套原创构图，保留两份候选，导出海报。整体风格与单项参数分开比较，确认后才保存有范围的偏好。
projects.descriptionEn: Put personal copy into six original compositions, keep two candidates and export a poster. Compare whole styles separately from individual parameters, then explicitly save scoped preferences.
metrics: 单变量对照与范围授权
偏好说明书 / SVG 导出
projects.context: 整张海报同时改变多种特征，单次选择无法说明原因。把它直接当成稳定偏好，还可能让工作和日常的需求互相干扰。
projects.contextEn: A choice between posters with several differences cannot isolate the cause. Treating it as a stable preference can also mix up work and everyday needs.
approach: 每个方向要真的改变构图：瑞士、解构、编辑杂志、包豪斯、日式留白和双色印刷使用不同几何与层级，展示同一份文案及容量提示。字号、换行和密度可微调；过密时保留内容、指出问题并暂停导出。
整体选择不偷换成参数结论：任意选择两方向比较，依据记为整体构图；只保存方向，不推断字体、色彩或留白。参数对照才保持其他条件不变。选中、导出与保存规则是三件独立的事。
下一张能复用，也能推翻：两份候选只存作品快照；确认过的偏好单独导出。JSON v1／旧 Markdown 说明书可再导入，先看替换项再确认，保留原场景与线索属性，且支持撤回。
approachEn: A direction must change the composition: Swiss, deconstructed, editorial, Bauhaus, Japanese whitespace and two-ink layouts have distinct geometry and hierarchy, with the same copy and capacity guidance. Type size, wrapping and density are adjustable. Dense copy is retained with an actionable warning before export.

Do not infer parameter preferences from a whole style: Any two named directions can be compared as whole compositions. Only the direction is recorded, without inferring type, colour or spacing. Parameter tests hold the rest constant. Choosing, exporting and saving memory are separate actions.

Reuse a preference without locking it in: Two candidates store artwork snapshots only. Confirmed preferences export separately. Import JSON v1 or previous Markdown briefs after reviewing replacements, retaining each context and clue/rule status, with undo available.
projects.result: 核心检查覆盖六构图、任意对照、过期状态、说明书往返与旧草稿兼容。浏览器与导出文件验收由本轮集成记录补充；尚无真人研究证明这些维度足以描述个人审美。 六套构图提供足够的差异，也明确容量边界，没有变成任意拖拽设计工具。字体依赖系统，SVG 跨设备字形可能不同；PNG 保留当前渲染。偏好规则不是人格测量或学习准确率。
projects.resultEn: Core checks cover six layouts, explicit pairs, stale states, brief round trips and old drafts. This iteration records browser and exported-file verification separately; no user study establishes that these dimensions represent personal taste. Six compositions offer meaningful differences with explicit capacity limits, rather than an unrestricted design editor. SVG fonts may differ across systems; PNG preserves the current render. Rules are not personality measurements or evidence of learning accuracy.

question.zh: 喜欢一张海报，能说明喜欢什么吗？
question.en: What did you like about that poster?

decision.zh: 六套原创构图、两份候选；先导出作品，确认范围后才复用偏好。
decision.en: Six original layouts and two candidates. Export the work, then explicitly scope reusable preferences.

projects.name: 随便局
projects.subtitle: 把「随便」说清楚
projects.description: “随便”之后总有人否决。把预算、距离和忌口变成各自可确认的条件；无交集时先预演，不替任何人妥协。
projects.descriptionEn: “Anything is fine” often ends in a veto. Make budget, distance and dietary needs explicit; preview voluntary changes when there is no overlap.
metrics: 自愿建议 → 预演 → 共同决定
3–5 位虚构角色 · 无需 Key
projects.context: 聚餐难题不只是候选餐厅少。一个人说“随便”，可能仍有预算或忌口；多数票会把少数人的限制当成可忽略的意见。
projects.contextEn: The problem is not simply a lack of restaurants. “Anything” can conceal budget or dietary limits, while majority voting may ignore a minority constraint.
approach: 硬条件不能被推荐抹掉：忌口、位置与明确排除条件保留。预算建议只有在本人调整能解锁候选时才出现，仍要由本人应用。
预演不等于同意：预演只显示可能的候选变化，不修改条件或表态。真正应用后，旧版本的接受状态失效。
最后带走的是共同决定：有效模拟成员都接受同一版本后才能形成决定单。公共导出不附带每个人未公开的私人输入。
approachEn: Recommendations cannot erase constraints: Dietary, location and excluded-option constraints remain. Budget suggestions appear only when a member’s own change unlocks an option, and still require application.
A preview is not consent: Preview shows possible changes without modifying constraints or votes. Applying a change invalidates acceptance of the old version.
Export a shared decision: A decision requires all active simulated members to accept the same version. Public exports omit private inputs that were not shared.
projects.result: 当前是可操作的单人模拟，成员与餐厅均虚构。能检查变更、确认与导出的状态关系，尚未验证真实多人使用、权限和真实商家信息。 共同确认比多数票慢。这个版本优先保护明确条件与决定权，是否会增加真实聚餐中的社交负担，需要真人任务验证。
projects.resultEn: This is an interactive single-user simulation with fictional people and restaurants. It demonstrates change, consent and export states, not real multiplayer, permissions or merchant coverage. Shared confirmation is slower than majority voting. This version prioritises explicit constraints and agency; whether it adds social friction needs real-user testing.
projects.demoNote: 单人模拟。确认小林条件后，可体验无交集 → 建议填入草稿 → 预演 → 本人确认 → 逐人接受 → 下载决定单。
projects.demoNoteEn: Single-person simulation: confirm constraints, try no-overlap, preview a voluntary draft, confirm, switch roles for unanimous acceptance and download a receipt.

question.zh: 大家都说随便，为什么还是选不出来？
question.en: Why is a group decision still so difficult?

decision.zh: 先收集硬条件；没有交集时预演，不替成员让步。
decision.en: Collect constraints, then preview a change without making it for someone.

caption.zh: 随便局 · 预算调整填入草稿，已确认条件与表态未变
caption.en: Suibianju · Budget draft preview; confirmed conditions and consent unchanged

projects.name: 有据
projects.subtitle: 从经验材料到可追溯的生活决策
projects.subtitleEn: From collected experience to traceable decisions
projects.description: 从相反经验中，找到适合自己的决定
projects.descriptionEn: Make a choice with conflicting experiences
projects.context: 经验很多，但哪些适合自己、相反意见如何权衡，往往不清楚。
projects.contextEn: Collected experiences do not make it clear which advice fits or how conflicting views should be weighed.
approach: 区分硬约束、偏好与待核实信息，明确标出方案冲突
保留材料依据、反方意见与行动前核实清单
approachEn: Separate hard constraints, preferences and unknowns; flag conflicting options.
Keep supporting material, opposing views and a pre-action verification checklist.
projects.result: 川西旅行与养猫家庭扫地机器人双场景 Demo；使用原创模拟资料，不接入实时搜索或电商价格。
projects.resultEn: Two demos: Western Sichuan travel and robot vacuums for cat-owning households. Uses original simulated material, not live search or e-commerce prices.
projects.demoNote: 先在首页选场景；推荐从未替用户自动做决定。扫地机器人场景的评论是演示样本，比价价格需手动输入。
projects.demoNoteEn: Choose either scenario on the homepage. Recommendations never make the final choice for the user. Product comments are simulated and comparison prices are entered manually.

question.zh: 经验互相矛盾，该相信哪一条？
question.en: Which advice applies when experiences conflict?

decision.zh: 对照来源、适用条件与自己的约束，再比较方案。
decision.en: Compare sources, applicability and personal constraints.

projects.name: Eval Lab
projects.subtitle: 从评分锚点，到有证据的版本评审
projects.subtitleEn: From scoring anchors to evidence-backed version review
projects.description: 带自己的创意文本，复制固定五维任务给已有的 AI，带回结果。核对原文、记录复核和处理项，再比较两份结果。
projects.descriptionEn: Bring creative text, take a fixed five-dimension task to an AI you already use, then return with results. Review evidence, track actions and compare two records.
projects.context: 固定样本只能让访客看懂界面。真正的任务是把自己的原文、外部评测、证据争议和待修改问题连起来；如果一切最后仍停在总分，作者带不走下一步。
projects.contextEn: Fixed samples explain an interface but do not finish a personal task. Authors need their text, external judgements, evidence disputes and unresolved changes together, rather than another overall score.
approach: 用自己的 AI，也能完成任务：任务包带完整 rubric、原系统 Prompt 和返回格式。用户自行运行后带回 JSON；本站看不到外部对话，模型、运行条件与时间仅为来源声明，不作认证。坏文件和取消不替换当前材料。
原始评价与处理行动分开：支持、存疑与需上下文分别记录。可把问题加入核查评语或修改原文的处理项，跟踪完成状态；完成处理不会回写原始分数，报告把未解决事项放在前面。
比较之前先核对条件：本机库最多20份，两侧按维度 ID 对齐。原文、模型或条件不同会提示；同一记录不重复计数。重复观察展示均值与极差，极差不是置信区间，也不自动宣布赢家或允许发布。
approachEn: Complete the task with an AI you already use: The package includes the complete rubric, original system Prompt and return format. Users run it elsewhere and return with JSON. External conversations are not visible; model, conditions and time are declarations, not certification. Failed or cancelled imports leave current material intact.

Keep judge output separate from follow-up work: Record support, disagreement and missing context separately. Track checking a judgement or revising text as follow-up work. Completing work does not change the original score; unresolved items lead the report.

Check conditions before comparing records: The local library holds up to 20 records, aligned by dimension ID. Text, model and condition differences stay visible, and duplicate records do not count twice. Repeats show means and ranges, not confidence intervals, winners or release permission.
projects.result: 6个样本的18次历史输出保持可回放。任务包、严格导入、资料上限、重复条件、处理项往返与报告顺序有程序检查；本轮浏览器集成证据另记，不能据此声称模型质量或生产准确率提升。 外部 AI 需要一次往返，但避免让公开作品集依赖共享 Key；五维限定创意文本，不能宣称支持任意评测体系。材料与人工判断仅在本机，库满不会自动淘汰旧记录。
projects.resultEn: Six samples and 18 saved runs remain replayable. Program checks cover the task package, strict imports, capacity, duplicate conditions, action round trips and report ordering. Browser integration evidence is recorded separately; none of this establishes better model quality or production accuracy. The external-AI round trip avoids a shared public Key. The five dimensions remain specific to creative text, not arbitrary rubrics. Records and reviews stay local; a full library never silently evicts older material.
projects.demoNote: 无需中转站体验历史回放和人工复核。可选接口仅按点击运行，Key 不持久保存；本轮未调用真实模型或重跑历史指标。
projects.demoNoteEn: No relay needed for replay and human review. Optional API runs require a click; keys are not persisted. No real models or historical benchmarks were rerun this round.

question.zh: 裁判给了低分，依据能经得起复核吗？
question.en: Does the evidence support the judge’s low score?

decision.zh: 自己的文本带回评测，保留原分；核对证据、记录处理项，再比较结果。
decision.en: Bring evaluations of your own text, preserve scores, review evidence, track actions and compare results.

projects.name: Filing Eval
projects.description: 把摘要拆成可核对的断言，再单独检查关键信息覆盖。原文、历史结果与人工复核各自保留。
projects.descriptionEn: Review individual claims and essential coverage separately. Preserve the source, saved results and human review.
metrics: 遗漏 / 争议分开核验
无需 Key 的历史回放
projects.subtitle: 逐条核查公告摘要的事实依据
projects.subtitleEn: Claim-level fact checking for filing summaries
projects.context: 只找错误会漏掉另一类风险：摘要省略了金额口径、限制条件或关键事件。一个总分难以说明问题出在哪一句，或者是哪句话根本没写。
projects.contextEn: Error checks miss absent conditions, amounts and events. A single score cannot identify either a false sentence or a missing one.
approach: 能回到原文：把具体断言与引用放在一起，定位失败时保留提示，不补造依据。
未保存不算已复核：复核结论和备注明确保存；未保存草稿与损坏记录不计入完成状态。
运行状态分开：历史结果、困难样本与尚未运行的候选留出集分别呈现。
approachEn: Return to the source: Link claims and quotations; keep failed locations visible rather than inventing evidence.
Drafts are not reviews: Save the verdict and note explicitly. Unsaved drafts and invalid records do not count as completed review.
Separate run status: Distinguish saved results, hard cases and unrun holdout candidates.
projects.result: 公开工具可回放 28 条构造公告，并核对原文与断言、记录和导出本机复核。 构造材料便于检查边界，不能据此声称真实公告上的准确率或泛化能力。
projects.resultEn: The public tool replays 28 constructed notices with source inspection and local review export. Constructed material helps inspect boundaries; it does not establish accuracy on real filings.
projects.demoNote: 28条模拟公告历史回放，不评估任意新文本；复核只存本机，损坏记录不计入进度，未保存草稿不冒充已审核。
projects.demoNoteEn: Replay of 28 synthetic filings, not live evaluation of arbitrary text. Reviews stay local; invalid records and unsaved drafts do not count as reviewed.

question.zh: 摘要没有写错，就足够完整吗？
question.en: Can a correct summary still miss something important?

decision.zh: 断言错误与关键信息遗漏分别核验，回到原文查证。
decision.en: Check false claims and missing facts separately against the source.

caption.en: Filing Eval · Source notice and claim review

projects.name: 企业 AI 与轻量业务工具
projects.subtitle: 把 AI 接入实际业务流程
projects.description: 从选品、问答和业务记录里的具体任务切入。拆开输入、工具输出与人的承诺，给缺失信息和失败留出退路。
projects.descriptionEn: Start with a concrete research, support or operations task. Separate input, tool output and human commitments, with recovery for gaps and failures.
projects.role: 企业 AI 应用实践
projects.context: 业务输入分散，价格、库存与交付条件会变。没有来源、确认和回退，自动化越快也可能越快传播错误。
projects.contextEn: Business inputs are fragmented and prices, stock and commitments change. Without sources, confirmation and recovery, automation can spread mistakes faster.
approach: 输入：任务与证据范围：明确要整理什么、依据来自哪里、哪些字段还未知。动态字段保留核验状态。
工具：结构化结果与出处：将候选、引用和操作记录拆开。没有来源的字段留空或待核验，不用流畅回答补齐。
接管：确认、退回与重新核对：价格与交付承诺交由人确认；输入不足或工具失败时，保留已完成部分并返回缺失项。条件变化后重新检查，不沿用旧同意。
approachEn: Input: task and evidence scope: Define the task, sources and unknown fields, retaining verification status for changing information.
Tools: structured output and sources: Separate candidates, citations and actions. Leave unsupported fields unknown rather than filling them with fluent prose.
Handoff: confirm, return and recheck: People confirm prices and commitments. Missing input or failed tools return explicit gaps. Changed conditions require rechecking rather than reusing old consent.
projects.result: 可公开检查的实现包括 Eval 的独立证据复核、随便局的无副作用条件预演和同版确认。上方链接直接进入这些机制与固定版本的源码。 这些公开 Demo 使用历史结果或本地规则，展示交互与状态机制。企业系统连接、客户采纳与效率收益需要在交付材料中分别核验。
projects.resultEn: Public implementations include independent evidence review in Eval and side-effect-free previews with versioned consent in Suibianju. The links above open the mechanisms and pinned source revisions. These public demos use saved outputs or local rules to demonstrate interaction and state mechanisms. Enterprise integrations, adoption and efficiency outcomes require separate delivery evidence.

question.zh: 业务流程里，哪一步值得先交给 AI？
question.en: Which part of a business workflow should AI handle first?

decision.zh: 从选品、问答与记录等具体任务切入，保留人工确认。
decision.en: Start with a concrete task and retain human confirmation.

projects.name: 个人投研 Agent 与量化研究
projects.subtitle: 从多源信息到可回查的研究记录
projects.subtitleEn: From multiple sources to traceable research records
projects.description: 多源研究、盘后复盘与样本外对照
metrics: 每日信息提炼：约 2 小时 → 20 分钟
projects.context: 个人投研存在信息过载与重复搜集，需要将资料获取、研究摘要和盘后复盘组织为可追溯任务。
projects.contextEn: Personal research involved information overload and repeated gathering, requiring traceable tasks from information collection to post-market review.
approach: 组织多源获取、内容结构化、情绪分析、研究摘要和盘后复盘，对接 IBKR API 及外部信息源
另建趋势、波动率与相对强弱研究模块，展示事件概率、20 日预期收益、下行风险、退出评分及主要多空因素
将策略与买入持有、均线退出、ATR 移动止损进行样本外对照，纳入交易成本与时间序列防泄漏设计
approachEn: Connected IBKR and external sources across gathering, structuring, sentiment, summary and post-market review tasks.
Built a separate module for trend, volatility and relative strength, showing event probabilities, 20-day expected returns, downside risk, exit scores and key factors.
Compared strategies out of sample with buy-and-hold, moving-average exits and ATR trailing stops, accounting for costs and temporal leakage.
projects.result: 每日投研信息获取与提炼耗时由约 2 小时缩短至 20 分钟；量化研究模块纳入交易成本与时间序列隔离，支持历史表现与适用边界检查。
projects.resultEn: Daily information gathering and synthesis fell from about two hours to twenty minutes. The quantitative research module accounts for trading costs and temporal separation to examine historical behaviour and applicability.

question.zh: 一份研究结论，怎样回到它的依据？
question.en: Can a research conclusion be traced to its sources?

decision.zh: 多源材料、研究记录与样本外对照分开组织。
decision.en: Keep source material, research records and out-of-sample comparisons distinct.

projects.name: 通勤方案比较器
projects.subtitle: 比较通勤成本、耗时与迟到风险
projects.subtitleEn: Compare commute cost, duration and lateness risk
projects.description: 比较路线的月费用与时间，再加入预算和最早愿意出门时刻。用试行记录预演校准，明确接受取舍，保存可重新确认的决定。
projects.descriptionEn: Compare monthly time and cost, add a budget and earliest willing departure, preview calibration with trial records and save a choice that can be reconfirmed.
metrics: 快速估算 → 实际记录
删改方案，其他结果不漂移
projects.context: 图表能列出哪个更快，却不知道一个人愿意为舒适、少换乘或早回家付多少。只给结论不保留输入，条件变了还容易沿用旧决定。
projects.contextEn: A chart cannot decide how much someone values comfort, fewer transfers or an earlier return. Without preserved inputs, an old decision may outlive its conditions.
approach: 条件差，比一个推荐分更具体：月预算与最早愿意出门时刻可选；逐路线说明多花多少、需要早出门多久。没有设置就不假装知道偏好，用户也可以明确接受条件外的方案。
少量记录先积累，不冒充校准：从结果补一次试行耗时，先预演再确认。少于三条明确显示积累中；三条起才用原经验重采样。只修改对应路线，另一条保持不变；输入变化会使旧预演失效。
来源可以恢复，选择需要重新确认：个人记录生效时不混改估计分布；切回估算要确认，并保留记录可恢复。预算、出门条件或记录变化都进入签名，旧选择保留为待重新确认的快照，不能冒充当前结果导出。
approachEn: Show the constraint gap, not a recommendation score: Budget and earliest departure are optional. Each route shows cost overruns or how much earlier departure is needed. Unset conditions imply no assumed preference; a person can explicitly accept an out-of-condition option.

Accumulate sparse records before calibration: Add a trial beside results, preview, then confirm. Fewer than three records are accumulation, not a calibrated distribution; three or more use the existing empirical resampling. Other routes stay intact, and changed inputs invalidate old previews.

Restore sources and reconfirm choices: Do not mix edited estimates with active records. Confirm a switch back to estimates while retaining recoverable records. Constraint and record changes enter the decision signature; old choices remain marked for reconfirmation and cannot export as current results.
projects.result: 个人条件、稀疏记录、预演失效、来源恢复、旧草稿与决策兼容有程序检查。真实输入、选择与导出仍需浏览器任务验收；没有真实出行准确率或节省时间的结论。 三条记录只是开始校准的操作门槛，不代表统计充分；相近时段的数据仍可能漏掉雨天和事故。月度往返采用返程同分布假设，条件差不等于未来准点承诺。
projects.resultEn: Program checks cover personal limits, sparse records, stale previews, restored sources and old drafts/decisions. Browser tasks verify input, choice and export separately. No real-world accuracy or time-saving result is claimed. Three records are an interaction threshold, not statistical sufficiency. Comparable observations may miss rain and incidents. Monthly return trips assume the same distribution; constraint gaps are not punctuality promises.

question.zh: 多花一点钱，能换回多少可靠时间？
question.en: How much reliable travel time does a higher fare buy?

decision.zh: 加上预算与出门条件，逐步补记录、预演校准，再保存自己的选择。
decision.en: Add budget and departure limits, collect trial records, preview calibration and save a choice.

caption.en: Commute Compare · Monthly tradeoffs, calibration and a decision card

projects.name: 扑克玩家类型测试
projects.description: 用十道题描述自己的打法
projects.descriptionEn: Describe your playing style in ten questions
projects.subtitle: 用十道题识别自己的扑克风格
projects.subtitleEn: Ten questions to identify your poker style
projects.context: 新手难以描述自己的打法，专业术语又提高了测试门槛。
projects.contextEn: Beginners struggle to describe their style, while specialist terms raise the entry barrier.
approach: 用三个行为维度组织十道题
提供专业与简单双模式，降低术语门槛
approachEn: Organize ten questions around three behavioral dimensions.
Offer professional and simple modes to reduce jargon barriers.

projects.resultEn: Live: complete the quiz and view a style profile.

projects.subtitle: 观察停止、曾经达标与最终达标的差异
projects.subtitleEn: Separate stopping, reaching a goal and finishing above it

projects.descriptionEn: Separate stopping, reaching and finishing above target

Ever reached vs finished above target

projects.name: Poker Lab · 手牌与训练
projects.subtitle: 真实算牌、范围训练与错题重练
projects.subtitleEn: Card equity, range practice and mistake review
projects.description: 按牌面算权益，按位置练开池，把错题留到下次。
projects.descriptionEn: Calculate card equity, practise opening ranges and revisit mistakes.
metrics: 真实牌面 · 加权范围
30 手基础题 · 可改参考
错题快照 · 本机备份
projects.context: 会用一个胜率数字，不等于能解释它的范围假设；练习后的偏离也需要能回到当时的依据。
projects.contextEn: An equity number needs a range assumption, and a practice mistake needs the reference used at the time.
approach: 在原 EV 工具上接入牌型评估，加入范围权重、已知牌排除、精确枚举与可复现抽样。
将位置参考、范围编辑和开池练习接成连续流程，按实际两张牌组合生成随机题。
错题保存当时的范围版本，支持重练、归档和备份；修改新参考不会改写旧题。
approachEn: Extend the existing EV tool with hand evaluation, weighted ranges, card removal, exact enumeration and reproducible sampling.
Connect positional charts, range editing and opening drills, sampling physical two-card holdings.
Keep each mistake tied to its original chart, with review, archiving and backup.
projects.result: 公开版在浏览器本地计算与保存。保留原 EV 沙盘；教学参考、抽样误差和完整策略的区别在界面与方法中说明。牌型引擎使用 phe，矩阵交互参考 Preflop Range Trainer，新增集成与验证记录随源码公开。
projects.resultEn: The public app computes and stores records locally, retains the original EV sandbox and explains its study scope. It uses phe and adapts matrix interaction from Preflop Range Trainer; integration and validation are documented in the source.

projects.name: Growth Experiment Lab
projects.subtitle: 从实验设计到结果解读的决策工具
projects.subtitleEn: A decision tool from experiment design to interpretation
projects.description: 把统计证据、业务最小效应和护栏分开。工具提供计算与计划，发布判断由人留下理由。
projects.descriptionEn: Separate statistical evidence, practical effect and guardrails. The tool calculates; a person records the decision.
metrics: 可取消模拟 · 参数溯源
计划与决策记录可导出
projects.context: 样本量足够时，很小的差异也可能显著；只看主指标，还可能忽略成本与护栏。计算证据和授权上线是不同的任务。
projects.contextEn: Small effects can become significant with enough data, while costs and guardrails remain unresolved. Evidence and rollout permission are different tasks.
approach: 先约定判断条件：区分基线、最小效应、样本和实验计划，避免看到结果后再改目标。
展示反复查看的代价：窥视模拟可以取消，参数与结果一起保留；模拟风险不冒充已发生的实验事故。
导出可追溯的判断：把计算结论、业务收益、护栏与决策理由放在同一份记录中，不自动批准上线。
approachEn: Define the decision criteria first: Keep baseline, minimum effect, sample and plan explicit instead of changing the target after seeing results.
Show the cost of peeking: Peeking simulation is cancellable and retains inputs. Simulated risk is not described as a real experiment incident.
Export a traceable decision: Export calculation, practical value, guardrails and reasoning without automatically authorising rollout.
projects.result: 可运行的设计与解读工具、模拟，以及计划和决策导出均可在浏览器检查。 假设检验依赖抽样与分流条件，当前演示没有接入真实流量，不能报告业务提升。
projects.resultEn: Planning, interpretation, simulation and plan/decision exports can be inspected in the browser. Inference depends on sampling and allocation assumptions. The demo has no live traffic and establishes no business uplift.

question.zh: 实验显著，就应该全量上线吗？
question.en: Does statistical significance justify a full rollout?

decision.zh: 分开看统计证据、业务收益与护栏，再留下决策记录。
decision.en: Separate statistical evidence, business value and guardrails.

projects.name: Pricing Model Sim
projects.subtitle: 比较三种付费机制的 LTV 与回本周期
projects.subtitleEn: Compare LTV and payback across three pricing mechanisms
projects.description: 订阅、解锁和混合机制放在同一人群口径下。一起检查收入、服务成本、留存与回本。
projects.descriptionEn: Compare subscription, unlock and hybrid mechanisms on a conserved cohort, including cost, retention and payback.
projects.context: 付费率、留存、解锁频次和成本如果分别使用不同口径，模型看起来精细，比较却失去意义。
projects.contextEn: Inconsistent conversion, retention, unlock and cost denominators can make a detailed comparison meaningless.
approach: 付费人群守恒：分别核对各机制人数和事件次数，不能把同一人重复算成新增付费者。
收益和成本一起推演：把留存、解锁与服务成本放在同一时间窗口下，回本不可达时明确显示。
结论随假设变化：比较不同情景与敏感参数，导出保留口径，不把单一默认值写成定价建议。
approachEn: Conserve paid populations: Check people and events separately without counting a person repeatedly as a new payer.
Model revenue and cost together: Keep retention, unlocks and service cost on one time horizon, showing unreachable payback explicitly.
Expose assumption sensitivity: Compare scenarios and sensitive assumptions, retaining definitions in exports rather than treating defaults as advice.
projects.result: 可检查三类机制、12 个月时间窗口及合成案例下的口径、账本和敏感性。 模型没有真实付费与留存校准，不能预测用户会接受哪个价格。
projects.resultEn: Inspect three mechanisms over 12 months using synthetic scenarios, ledgers and sensitivity analysis. The model is not calibrated on live payments or retention and cannot predict price acceptance.

question.zh: 付费机制变了，比较口径还一致吗？
question.en: Are payment models being compared on the same cohort?

decision.zh: 固定人群口径，核对留存、解锁、成本与回本。
decision.en: Conserve the cohort while checking retention, unlocks, costs and payback.

projects.name: Bundle Lab
projects.subtitle: 从订单共现中发现套餐机会
projects.subtitleEn: Discover bundle opportunities from co-purchased items
projects.description: 带自己的商品假设，保留最多三份方案。分开看新增贡献与既有让利，用折扣×采纳条件地图检查结论，再留下选择理由。
projects.descriptionEn: Bring product assumptions and keep up to three scenarios. Separate new contribution from discount leakage, test discount/adoption conditions and record a reasoned choice.
projects.context: 从订单共现直接跳到“做套餐”，容易把相关性当成效果。更高的客单也不等于更高收益，需要核对新增购买、让利、毛利与采纳假设。
projects.contextEn: Jumping from co-occurrence to a bundle confuses association with impact. Higher order value does not establish better contribution; adoption, margin and discount leakage matter.
approach: 先冻结方案，再比较改了什么：第一份方案为 A 基准；最多三份独立快照对齐商品、价格、人群、假设、贡献、让利与平衡点。复制到当前草稿再调整，原快照不随滑杆漂移，方案收益也不相加。
问结论在哪些条件下翻转：折扣×中档采纳的每个格点调用同一个收益函数，其余成本和人群固定。点击先预演，与当前结果对照；确认后才修改输入。正负区域是条件算例，不是收益概率或价格弹性。
选择之后仍要验证假设：人明确选择并填写理由，导出参数、差异、账本与下一步验证。未选择也可导出，但保留“尚未选择”；Growth 与 Pricing 仍是次级分析工具，不自动宣布全量上线。
approachEn: Freeze a scenario before comparing changes: A is the baseline. Up to three independent snapshots align products, prices, populations, assumptions, gains, leakage and break-even. Copy into a draft before editing; sliders never alter a saved scenario, and scenario returns are not added together.

Find the conditions that reverse the conclusion: Every discount/adoption grid point calls the same model with costs and populations held fixed. Preview against the current result before applying it. Positive and negative regions are conditional calculations, not profit probabilities or elasticity.

A choice still needs assumption checks: People explicitly choose and explain, exporting inputs, changes, ledgers and validation steps. An unchosen export says so. Growth and Pricing remain related analysis tools, not automatic rollout permission.
projects.result: 沿用4,000条合成订单与既有收益模型。快照、差异、损坏恢复和条件地图格点有确定性检查；本轮浏览器任务另行验收，不把模拟正收益写成真实增长。 保留方案比只动滑杆多一步，却能防止凭记忆比较。二维地图固定其他变量，不代表真实采纳会如何随折扣变化；每100覆盖订单是统一比较单位，不是观测订单。
projects.resultEn: The original 4,000 synthetic orders and contribution model remain. Deterministic checks cover snapshots, differences, corrupt recovery and grid points. Browser tasks are verified separately; simulated positive returns are not observed growth. Keeping a scenario adds a step but avoids comparison from memory. The map fixes other variables and does not predict how adoption responds to discounts. Per 100 covered orders is a comparison unit, not an observed sample.

question.zh: 套餐卖得更多，为什么反而少赚了？
question.en: Why can a bundle sell more and still earn less?

decision.zh: 保存三方案，预演折扣与采纳条件；分开算新增和让利，再留下选择理由。
decision.en: Keep three scenarios, preview discount/adoption conditions, separate gains from leakage and record a rationale.

projects.name: 可信 RAG 实验台
projects.subtitle: 答案依据从哪里来，为什么可以用
projects.subtitleEn: Where evidence comes from and why it applies
projects.description: 对原创制度资料做真实检索，先限定日期、版本和可访问范围，再检查答案与引文。换条件后，旧答案明确待重新检索。
projects.descriptionEn: Retrieve original policy material after setting date, version and access scope. Inspect the answer and citation; mark old results stale when conditions change.
metrics: 原创示例 / 本地 API
projects.context: 旧版本、未来规则或无权访问的资料都可能包含相近语句。只让回答带引用，不足以证明这份资料对当前问题、日期和身份适用。
projects.contextEn: Older versions, future rules and inaccessible material can all contain similar language. Attaching a citation does not prove its applicability to the current question, date and role.
approach: 把日期与版本作为输入：同一显示器问题，在原始快照的 2026-06-30 查到 30 天，在 2026-10-28 查到 14 天；演示修订快照为 10 天。每个结果都有对应版本和原文。
条件改变，不沿用旧结论：首页预览先标明旧答案待更新，用户重新查找后才替换结果。它复用完整工具的检索引擎与公开资料，不另写答案映射表。
公开演示与服务端能力分开：公开包只含十二份公开虚构资料。身份切换用于体验，不能证明生产鉴权；本地 API 在检索前执行范围检查，管理侧测试资料不会进入公开预览。
approachEn: Make date and version explicit inputs: The same monitor question yields 30 days on 2026-06-30 and 14 days on 2026-10-28 in the baseline snapshot; the demonstration revision yields 10. Each result has its own version and source.

A changed scope invalidates an old conclusion: The homepage marks the old answer stale and updates it only after a new search. It reuses the full tool’s retrieval engine and public corpus, rather than a hardcoded answer table.

Separate public demonstration from server enforcement: The public corpus contains twelve fictional public documents. Role switching demonstrates a scenario, not production authentication. The local API enforces scope before retrieval, and admin-only test documents are excluded from public previews.
projects.result: 浏览器可真实执行 BM25 检索、版本选择与规则摘录，并展开引用段落。条件算例的 30 / 14 / 10 天分别来自对应原文；引用定位与关键事实检查不冒充模型语义评估。 规则摘录方便核对，但适用范围比自由生成窄。身份模拟不能替代真实服务端鉴权，构造资料上的检索检查也不能证明真实企业知识库的效果。
projects.resultEn: The browser performs actual BM25 retrieval, version selection and rule extraction with inspectable sources. The 30 / 14 / 10 day examples come from their respective paragraphs; citation and extracted-fact checks are not model semantic evaluations. Rule extraction is inspectable but narrower than free generation. Role simulation cannot replace server authentication, and constructed-corpus checks do not establish performance on an enterprise knowledge base.

question.zh: 引用同一份资料，为什么答案仍可能错？
question.en: Why can a cited answer still be wrong?

decision.zh: 先限定日期、版本与可访问范围；条件改变后重新检索。
decision.en: Set date, version and access scope before retrieval; search again when conditions change.

principles.dz: 多数做不下去的需求，是因为一开始没说清要解决什么。我习惯先把问题写成一句话，写不出来就说明还没想明白。

principles.en: A metric needs a failure condition
principles.dz: 定指标的时候同时定清楚：什么情况算没达到。没有失败条件的指标只是装饰。
principles.de: When setting a metric, also define what counts as missing it. A metric without a failure condition is decoration.

principles.en: Do it yourself when you can
principles.dz: 写需求之前先把流程亲自走一遍。走一遍才知道哪一步是多余的、哪一句话会被理解错。
principles.de: Before writing a spec, walk the flow myself. Only then do I find which step is redundant and which sentence will be misread.

about.body3: 我喜欢先把想法做成能操作的版本，让用户用起来，再看反馈和数据。能否进入真实工作、哪些结果可以验证，是我判断一个 AI 产品是否有用的起点。
about.body3En: I like making an idea usable, putting it in front of people and examining their feedback and the data. Whether it fits real work, and which outcomes can be verified, is where I start judging an AI product.

Capability is abundant, judgement is scarce
items.dz: 模型能做的事已经远多于产品里用上的事。今天多数 AI 产品的瓶颈不在模型，在有没有人把它放进一个真实场景，定义清楚它要解决的具体问题。这是产品的活，不是算法的活。
items.de: Models can already do far more than products make use of. The bottleneck in most AI products today is not the model. It is whether someone has placed it in a real scenario and defined the specific problem it must solve. That is product work, not algorithm work.

text.zh: 在 RAG 实验台，引用之前先检查日期和资料版本；条件变化后，旧答案必须重新检索。
text.en: RAG Lab checks dates and source versions before citations. A change in scope requires a fresh search.

items.dz: 一个 AI 功能「好不好」，不能靠感觉。我倾向于先把评测标准建出来再谈效果。标准本身就是产品的一部分，它决定了团队朝哪个方向优化，也决定了上线之后谁来说「够了」。
items.de: Whether an AI feature is "good" cannot rest on feel. I prefer to build the evaluation standard before discussing results. The standard is part of the product: it decides which direction the team optimises toward, and who gets to say "enough" after launch.

text.zh: Eval 保留裁判原分；人的不同判断另记，不回写成更好看的分数。
text.en: Eval retains the original score and records human disagreement separately.

items.zh: 接下来十年是 Agent 的十年，不是 Agent 的一年
items.en: The decade of agents, not the year
items.dz: 自动驾驶从演示到落地用了十几年，Agent 也一样。真正有价值的不是全自动的炫技，是让人能调节自主程度、在关键节点快速验证的「半自动」产品。做这类产品，交互设计和验证效率比模型能力更重要。
items.de: Self-driving took over a decade from demo to deployment, and agents will follow the same arc. The value is not in fully autonomous showpieces but in "partially autonomous" products where people can dial autonomy up or down and verify quickly at key points. For such products, interaction design and verification speed matter more than raw model capability.
items.refLabel: Hamel Husain · Your AI Product Needs Evals

text.zh: Agent 执行台把批准、写入与最终状态分开。超时先查原操作，不把“没收到回执”当成失败。
text.en: Agent Bench separates approval, writes and final state. A timeout calls for reconciliation, not an assumption that the write failed.

items.zh: To C 看留存，To B 看替换成本
items.en: Consumer AI is about retention, enterprise AI is about switching cost
items.dz: 消费端的 AI 产品，新鲜感过后拼的还是留存：用户愿不愿意每天回来。企业端的关键是替换成本：AI 方案比旧流程好多少，才值得客户承担切换的代价。两边都不是「有 AI」就赢，是「AI 让哪个数字变了」才赢。
items.de: Once novelty fades, consumer AI competes on retention: will people come back every day. On the enterprise side the question is switching cost: how much better than the old process must the AI solution be for a customer to bear the cost of change. Neither side wins by "having AI". They win by "which number AI moved".
